title: Petition of Holyoke Gas and Electric Department for authorization and approval of increase in depreciation rate cost of its gas plant from three percent to five percent for the year 1989.
filings: ORDER ISSUED. Commissioners: McIntyre, Werlin, Tierney (90-11C).
Holyoke Gas & Electric Department, for authorization and approval of an increase in depreciation rate, on the cost of plant from 3% to 5% for the year of 1989.
